# 考試系統 (Examination System)

> 純前端、零執行期依賴的線上練習與模擬考平台（繁體中文介面），內建 11 套 ERP、iPAS AI、專案管理與理財規劃題庫，支援模擬考與練習模式、錯題重練、簡答題自評、進度自動保存、歷史趨勢與 JSON／CSV 匯出。A client-side practice and mock exam platform with zero runtime dependencies (Traditional Chinese UI) that ships 11 question banks and supports exam and practice modes, wrong-answer retry, short-answer self-grading, auto-saved progress, score trends and JSON / CSV export.

- 線上版 Live site：https://scorpio-meow.github.io/Examination-System/ ，可用 `?bank=<檔名>` 預選題庫 / preselect a bank with `?bank=<file name>`.
- 架構 Architecture：靜態檔案 + ES modules + hash 路由（`#/`、`#/exam`、`#/result`、`#/history`），資料只存在瀏覽器 localStorage，最後更新後保留 7 天 / Static files, ES modules and hash routes; data stays in browser localStorage for 7 days after its last update.
- 題庫白名單 Bank whitelist：只載入列在 `json/banks.json`、檔名符合 `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _.-]*\.json$` 且位於 `json/` 資料夾內的檔案 / Only files listed in `json/banks.json`, matching that pattern and inside `json/` are loaded.
- 題目格式 Question format：單選 single choice `{ "id", "question", "options": ["A. …", "B. …"], "answer": "A", "explanation" }`；簡答 short answer `{ "id", "type": "SAQ", "question", "answer", "explanation" }`。
- 新增題庫 Adding a bank：放入 `json/`、在 `json/banks.json` 加一筆 `file`／`group`／`title`／`shortTitle`，再執行 `bun run build:banks` / put the file in `json/`, add an entry to `json/banks.json`, then run `bun run build:banks`.
- 開發 Development：`bun test` 執行單元測試，`bun run check:banks` 檢查題庫統計是否過期 / `bun test` runs the unit tests and `bun run check:banks` reports stale bank statistics.
- 定位 Scope：題目與答案公開於瀏覽器端，僅供自學練習，不適用於需要防弊的正式考試 / Questions and answers are public in the browser, so this is a self-study tool and not suitable for proctored exams.

## 文件 Docs

- [README（繁體中文）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/README.md): 功能、設定、快捷鍵、題庫格式、檔案結構、疑難排解與常見問題
- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/README.en.md): Features, settings, shortcuts, bank schema, file structure, troubleshooting and FAQ
- [ADR-002 前端重構](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/docs/adr/ADR-002-frontend-architecture.md): 模組劃分、題庫目錄、hash 路由、作答 session v2、原生對話框與無障礙互動模型的決策與取捨
- [ADR-002 Front-end rewrite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/docs/adr/ADR-002-frontend-architecture.en.md): Decisions and trade-offs for modules, the bank catalog, hash routing, session v2, native dialogs and the accessible interaction model
- [ADR-001 用戶端資料安全](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/docs/adr/ADR-001-local-security-validation.md): 結構驗證、設定清理、CSP 與 CSV 防護；第 1 點的白名單已由 ADR-002 取代 / Schema validation, config sanitizing, CSP and CSV protection; its whitelist item is superseded by ADR-002

## 程式模組 Source modules

- [index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/index.html): 頁面骨架、CSP、四個畫面、對話框與 SVG 圖示 / Page skeleton, CSP, four views, dialogs and SVG icons
- [app.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/app.js): 進入點：啟動、路由守衛、題庫載入、跨畫面流程與資料清除 / Entry point: startup, route guards, bank loading, cross-view flows and data clearing
- [js/catalog.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/catalog.js): 題庫目錄驗證、檔名白名單、題庫網址解析 / Catalog validation, filename whitelist, bank URL resolution
- [js/bank.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/bank.js): 題庫下載與正規化，不合格題目略過並回報 / Bank download and normalization; invalid questions are skipped and reported
- [js/session.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/session.js): 抽題、隨機排序、作答、標記、練習模式鎖定、批改與簡答題比對 / Drawing, shuffling, answering, flags, practice locking, grading and short-answer matching
- [js/storage.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/storage.js): localStorage TTL、設定清理、session 與紀錄驗證、v3 資料轉換 / localStorage TTL, config sanitizing, session and record validation, v3 migration
- [js/history.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/history.js): 歷史紀錄整理與題庫最近／最佳成績 / History records and per-bank last and best scores
- [js/export.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/export.js): JSON／CSV 匯出，UTF-8 BOM 與公式字元轉義 / JSON and CSV export with UTF-8 BOM and formula escaping
- [js/router.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/router.js): hash 路由 / Hash routing
- [js/ui.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/ui.js): `<dialog>` 對話框、確認框、Toast 與選單 / Dialogs, confirmations, toasts and menus
- [js/theme.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/theme.js): 深淺色切換與網址列顏色同步 / Light and dark toggle with theme-color sync
- [js/color-scheme.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/color-scheme.js): 頁面載入前套用外觀偏好，防止閃爍 / Applies the saved scheme before render to prevent a flash
- [js/dom.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/dom.js): 以 textContent 安全建立 DOM、時間與日期格式化 / Safe DOM building with textContent, time and date formatting
- [js/views/home.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/views/home.js): 首頁：題庫卡片、開始設定、繼續進度 / Home: bank cards, start panel, resume card
- [js/views/exam.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/views/exam.js): 考試頁：作答、題號地圖、交卷、計時與快捷鍵 / Exam: answering, question map, submission, timer and shortcuts
- [js/views/result.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/views/result.js): 結果頁：成績摘要、回顧分頁、簡答題自評、匯出 / Result: score summary, review tabs, self-grading, export
- [js/views/history.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/js/views/history.js): 歷史紀錄頁：分數趨勢圖與紀錄表 / History: score trend chart and records
- [style.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/style.css): `@layer` 分層樣式表與淺色／深色 token / Layered stylesheet with light and dark tokens

## 題庫 Question banks

- [json/banks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/banks.json): 題庫目錄：預設題庫、分組、標題、短名與自動產生的題數統計 / Bank catalog: default bank, groups, titles, short names and generated statistics
- [ERP 規劃師 參考題型](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/ERP%20Planner_Reference%20Question%20Types_202509_V06.json): 443 題單選，含解析 / 443 single-choice questions with explanations
- [ERP 基礎檢定 學科參考題型](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/PFERP_Reference119_20240201.json): 119 題單選，無解析 / 119 single-choice questions without explanations
- [iPAS AI L11 A 卷 基礎與治理](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L11-A.json): 45 題單選，含解析 / 45 single-choice questions with explanations
- [iPAS AI L11 B 卷 基礎與治理](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L11-B.json): 45 題單選，含解析 / 45 single-choice questions with explanations
- [iPAS AI 114 年初級科目一 L1101 #130994](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L11-130994.json): 50 題單選，含解析 / 50 single-choice questions with explanations
- [iPAS AI L12 A 卷 生成式 AI 應用與規劃](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L12-A.json): 35 題單選，含解析 / 35 single-choice questions with explanations
- [iPAS AI L12 B 卷 生成式 AI 應用與規劃](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L12-B.json): 35 題單選，含解析 / 35 single-choice questions with explanations
- [iPAS AI L12 C 卷 生成式 AI 應用與規劃](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L12-C.json): 35 題單選，含解析 / 35 single-choice questions with explanations
- [iPAS AI L12 D 卷 生成式 AI 應用與規劃](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/IPAS-AI-L12-D.json): 35 題單選，含解析 / 35 single-choice questions with explanations
- [專案管理](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/Project_Management.json): 50 題單選，含解析 / 50 single-choice questions with explanations
- [理財規劃](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Scorpio-meow/Examination-System/HEAD/json/Basic_Financial_Planning.json): 151 題（單選 138、簡答 13），無解析 / 151 questions (138 single choice, 13 short answer) without explanations
